name: Runemaster audit #2755: Volcanic Etching raises Fire and Earth Engraving proc chance
contract: Volcanic Etching 705615: 'Increases the chance to trigger Weapon Engraving: Fire and Weapon Engraving: Earth
by $s1%.' Re-verified in Spell.dbc: single Effect0 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107), MiscValue 18 =
SPELLMOD_CHANCE_OF_SUCCESS, EffectBasePoints0 4 with DieSides 1 = +5%, EffectSpellClassMask mask1 2 (0x2)
and mask2 33554432 (0x2000000) on family 38. Fire Engraving 653211 carries SpellFamilyName 38,
SpellFamilyFlags[1] 2 (base ProcChance 30) - an exact match on mask1. Earth Engraving 653221 carries
SpellFamilyFlags[2] 33554432 (base ProcChance 15) - an exact match on mask2, and its own proc chain is fixed
spell_modifier probe exercises Volcanic Etching's own classmask match independently of whether either
engraving actually procs at runtime. Expected: before the talent both base chances read unmodified (30% and
15%); with the talent both rise by 5 points (35% and 20%); unlearning restores Fire Engraving's base chance.
